_doc: The Loom: the hero's skills (docs/GAME_DESIGN.md#skills-the-loom). params: name -> [value at rank 1, change per rank]. slot: the input that casts it (skill_1 = right mouse, skill_2..5 = Q W E R). cost is ichor; cooldown in seconds.

lunge.name: Lunge
lunge.desc: Drive forward with spear or blade, striking every foe in your path for {damage}% weapon damage over {distance} m.

aspis_bash.name: Aspis Bash
aspis_bash.desc: Smash your shield into the foes before you: {damage}% weapon damage, stunned for {stun} s.

fates_lash.name: Fate's Lash
fates_lash.desc: Unspool the golden thread and whip it around you: {damage}% weapon damage within {radius} m, dragging foes toward you.

war_cry.name: War Cry of Ares
war_cry.desc: Bellow the war-god's name: +{damage_pct}% damage and +{speed_pct}% attack speed for {duration} s. Foes nearby falter.

bound_shades.name: Bound Shades
bound_shades.desc: Snare wandering shades with golden thread; {count} fight beside you for {duration} s.

atropos_mercy.name: Atropos' Mercy
atropos_mercy.desc: Your blows find the frayed end of every thread: foes under {threshold}% health are severed outright. Bosses are spared.
